questions.question: A car suddenly cuts in front of you. What should you do first?
questions.explanation: If a car pulls in front of you too close, release the gas pedal. This gives you space between you and the car ahead without hard braking or swerving.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A yellow diamond sign warns you of danger ahead. Orange diamond signs warn of danger in or near work zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead will be slippery.

questions.explanation: This sign means a divided highway begins ahead. Stay to the right of the center divider.

questions.question: A single broken yellow line in the center of a two-lane road means:

options.text: Traffic moves in opposite directions. You cannot pass.
Traffic moves in opposite directions. You can pass when safe.
Traffic moves in the same direction. You cannot pass.
Traffic moves in the same direction. You can pass when safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic moves in opposite directions. You can pass when safe.
questions.explanation: Yellow lines separate traffic moving in opposite directions. A dashed line means you can pass when it is safe to do so.

questions.question: A curb painted ____ shows a loading zone or parking restriction.
questions.explanation: Painted curbs show parking rules. A yellow curb marks a loading zone or other parking restriction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You might damage a tire on the shoulder.
You could lose control if your wheel goes onto the shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: You could lose control if your wheel goes onto the shoulder.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the shoulder is lower than the road. If one wheel drops off the road, do not brake hard or steer sharply. This could cause you to lose control.

questions.question: You reach an intersection with stop signs on all four corners at the same time as a driver on your left. Who goes first?
questions.explanation: When two cars reach a four-way stop at the same time, the car on the right has the right-of-way.

questions.question: A solid white line on the road's right edge angles toward the center. This means:
questions.explanation: A solid edge line marks the boundary between the road and shoulder. When this line angles toward the center, the road is narrowing ahead.

questions.question: Which is NOT a factor in how far it takes to stop your vehicle?
questions.explanation: Stopping distance depends on perception time, reaction distance, and braking distance. These change with speed and road conditions.

questions.question: If your vehicle starts to skid, you should:
questions.explanation: If your vehicle skids, do not use the brakes. Braking can make the skid worse.

questions.question: You cannot cross a single broken white or yellow line:

options.text: If it would interfere with other traffic.
When turning left into a driveway.
When the car in front of you is broken down.
When passing to the right on a one-way street.

questions.correctAnswerText: If it would interfere with other traffic.
questions.explanation: You can cross a single broken line to pass or change lanes if you can do so safely and without interfering with other traffic.

questions.question: To check your blind spot when changing lanes to the left, you should look:
questions.explanation: To check your blind spot, look over your shoulder in the direction you want to move.

questions.question: Which of the following helps direct drivers into the correct lanes for turning on some highways?

options.text: White lines on the side of the road.
White arrows in the middle of the lanes.

questions.correctAnswerText: White arrows in the middle of the lanes.
questions.explanation: White arrows show which lanes to use for driving straight or turning.

questions.question: You should allow extra space in front of your car when stopping:
questions.explanation: Leave extra space when stopped on an uphill slope. If the car in front rolls backward, the extra space prevents a collision.

questions.question: There are oncoming cars on your left and parked cars on your right. You should steer:

options.text: Closer to the oncoming cars than the parked cars.
Closer to the parked cars than the oncoming cars.
Between the oncoming and parked cars.

questions.correctAnswerText: Between the oncoming and parked cars.
questions.explanation: When oncoming cars are on your left and parked cars are on your right, steer between them.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. They alert drivers to watch for animals, people, and vehicles that may cross the road.

questions.question: When you see a stopped school bus on the opposite side of a divided highway, you:

options.text: Must stop until the school bus starts moving.
Must stop until the stop arm is lifted.
Must stop until the flashing lights turn off.

questions.explanation: On a divided highway, you can keep driving past a stopped school bus on the opposite side. If the highway has no median, you must stop from both directions.

questions.question: You are in an intersection when an emergency vehicle approaches with its siren and flashing lights. You should:

options.text: Pull to the right of the intersection and stop.
Finish crossing the intersection, pull to the right, and stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Finish crossing the intersection, pull to the right, and stop.
questions.explanation: If you are in an intersection when an emergency vehicle approaches, finish crossing. Then drive to the right and stop. You must give way to police cars, fire trucks, ambulances, and other emergency vehicles using sirens or flashing lights.

questions.question: If you see heavy smoke ahead on the road, you should:

options.text: Turn on your hazard lights and keep driving.
Slow down, move to the right, and stop off the road.
Turn on your high beams and keep driving.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, move to the right, and stop off the road.
questions.explanation: If you see heavy smoke ahead, slow down right away. Drive as far to the right as possible and stop off the road. Then decide if it is safe to continue. Some smoke can harm your eyes, lungs, or be dangerous.

questions.question: Round signs warn of:
questions.explanation: Round signs warn drivers of an upcoming railroad crossing. Drive with extra caution when you see this sign.

questions.question: When parking downhill on a two-way street, what should you do with your wheels?

options.text: Turn your wheels to the right.
Turn your wheels to the left.
Keep your wheels pointed straight ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn your wheels to the right.
questions.explanation: Turn your wheels toward the side of the road when parking downhill. If your car rolls, it will roll away from traffic and toward the curb.

questions.question: When must you give the right-of-way to a pedestrian?
questions.explanation: You must yield to pedestrians crossing any street, whether it is marked or unmarked. Always put safety first.

questions.question: What does a green arrow on a lane use control signal mean?

options.text: The signal is about to change to a red X.
Drivers should not drive in this lane.
Drivers may use this lane only to make a left turn.
Drivers may drive normally in this lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drivers may drive normally in this lane.
questions.explanation: Lane use control signals show which lanes are open or closed. A green arrow means you can drive normally in that lane.

questions.question: When should you increase the distance between your vehicle and the car ahead?

options.text: Are following a small passenger vehicle.
Are being tailgated by another driver.
Are driving more slowly than the posted speed limit.

questions.correctAnswerText: Are being tailgated by another driver.
questions.explanation: Create extra space in front of your vehicle when being tailgated. Slow down gradually or change lanes. Do not brake suddenly.

questions.question: When should you slow down on a freeway exit ramp?

options.text: Slow down before entering the exit ramp.
Slow down once moving onto the exit ramp.
Keep your speed constant once in the exit ramp.
Pass slower traffic in the exit ramp.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down once moving onto the exit ramp.
questions.explanation: Stay at freeway speed until you move onto the exit ramp. Then slow down.
